name: Celibacy
overview: Scripture presents celibacy as a distinct calling that not all are able to embrace, highlighting that some choose to remain unmarried for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. Jesus acknowledges different types of eunuchs—those born so, made so by others, and those who voluntarily abstain from marriage for spiritual reasons. The Apostle Paul affirms that it is good for a man not to touch a woman, yet he also recognizes marriage as a safeguard against fornication, emphasizing that celibacy is a gift from God given to some individuals. Thus, celibacy is portrayed as a purposeful and God-ordained state that serves a higher spiritual purpose when received as a gift.
